description: A ground-level photograph depicting an olive grove on a dry, gently sloping hillside. Several mature olive trees with green foliage and visible trunks are planted in discernible rows, casting shadows on the brown, sparsely vegetated ground. Patches of dry, golden-brown grass and some greener shrubs are visible in the foreground. The background shows a continuation of the hillside covered with more trees, extending towards a blue sky with scattered white clouds. This image illustrates an example of an olive grove, which is classified as CORINE Land Cover (CLC) class 2.2.2, "Olive groves," within the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) nomenclature guidelines.
